name: Aircall
one_liner: Aircall is a cloud-based call center and business phone system with click-to-dial, call routing, and CRM integrations.
auto_notes: pass1/pass2 disagree on access (self_serve_free vs paid_plan)

evidence.quote: Use Basic Auth if you are an Aircall customer building for your own account only.
Aircall implemented the OAuth 2.0 authentication protocol so you can easily build an app on top of Aircall and deploy it on Aircall's Marketplace.
OAuth credentials — If you haven't received them yet, apply to the Tech Partner program
The foundation for every Aircall integration is the REST API
Unauthenticated probe -> HTTP 401; WWW-Authenticate: None; body: {"message":"Unauthorized"}

notes: Two auth tracks: (1) Basic Auth with a self-generated api_id/token, available to any Aircall customer on a paid plan (even entry-level Essentials includes "API access") for building against your own account only; (2) OAuth2, required for multi-tenant Marketplace apps, which requires applying to and being approved by Aircall's Technology Partner program (client_id/client_secret issued after approval). No official Aircall-published MCP server found; several unofficial community MCP servers exist on GitHub with low star counts. Not present in Composio catalog. API surface appears CRM/telephony-resource sized (calls, contacts, users, numbers, teams, tags, webhooks, insights) — treated as small/unknown breadth since no endpoint count was directly verified.
